workforceModel.status: Digital and IT mature-team high-water model with a four-post permanent core and unresolved specialist/service sourcing
workforceModel.summary: The high-water funding model should not imply that every costed Digital and IT line becomes a permanent Student Hub post, but neither should it hide the enduring product capability that King’s is deliberately creating. The current planning assumption is therefore a 4.0 FTE permanent Digital and IT core from the outset: Product Manager, Backend Engineer, Full-Stack Developer and UX/UI Designer. Mobilisation investment carries these posts to June 2029 and recurrent Digital and IT establishment takes over from July 2029, with the Product Manager cost allocation still to be agreed with the Staff Digital Hub. The remaining mature-team lines are kept as high-water specialist or service capacity until Digital and IT confirms whether they are dedicated, shared, existing or externally sourced. Mark Peace as Product Owner and the expected existing IT Delivery Manager remain existing capacity rather than funded appointments.
